paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Zohar, Lekh Lekha, [folio] 98b.[^1]

notes.text: The whole notice points to the Zohar, Lekh Lekha, צח: (98b by the usual numeral and side convention). The older note described the letters and colon; this reading does not verify an edition or modern locator. No additional biography or title is supplied.
